_comment: Deployment facts for this project, read by morfdeploy. The four install steps live in one place for the whole parc; this file states only what is specific to this service.
_comment_app_dir: Overridden by MORF_APP_DIR, one variable for every service. The old per-project spellings (MT_/MN_/MS_) are still honoured with a notice.
_comment_configs: Copied at install. Never overwritten by default: these hold settings edited by hand on the machine. An absolute destination is honoured as-is, which is how the shared parc file reaches /etc/morfsystem.
_comment_config_dir: La configuration vit sous /etc/morfsystem/<service> : un point d'entree UNIQUE dans /etc pour tout le parc, et non a cote du binaire dans /opt. Effacer /opt/<service> pour reinstaller proprement n'emporte donc pas les reglages.
_comment_state_dir: ETAT PERSISTANT (docs/FILESYSTEM.md) : cache SQLite des echantillons sous /var/lib/morfsystem/morfanalytics, distinct de la config (/etc, admin) et du programme (/opt). L'unite declare StateDirectory=morfsystem/morfanalytics : systemd cree ce dossier possede par le user du service, expose via $STATE_DIRECTORY (dossier de cache par defaut). La cle 'cache_dir' d'un module permet de surcharger cet emplacement.
